data.description: The Tai Chi Cum Standing Twister joins two standing stations. On one side, the user turns a pair of tai chi spinner wheels with both hands in slow circles, which loosens the shoulders and upper back. On the other side, a standing twister turns the hips and waist. Together they give a gentle routine for the upper and lower body that older residents can do in a few minutes after their walk. This combination is part of our Fun Fitness range, and its listed colour is Play Orange. Its footprint and warranty terms come with your quotation. On the Tai Chi Cum Standing Twister, we will confirm cover in the quote; our standard terms give 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings.

items.pText: The Tai Chi Cum Standing Twister joins two standing stations. On one side, the user turns a pair of tai chi spinner wheels with both hands in slow circles, which loosens the shoulders and upper back. On the other side, a standing twister turns the hips and waist. Together they give a gentle routine for the upper and lower body that older residents can do in a few minutes after their walk. This combination is part of our Fun Fitness range, and its listed colour is Play Orange. Its footprint and warranty terms come with your quotation. On the Tai Chi Cum Standing Twister, we will confirm cover in the quote; our standard terms give 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings.

The spinner wheels and the twister platform all run on bearings, so check each one for free movement at every service visit. The frame is fixed self-standing or grouted. Place it so the two users face away from each other and neither stands in a walkway.
